variants.name: Barbell Back Squat
variants.setup: Set the bar in the rack at upper-chest height, safeties just below your bottom position. Bar on upper traps, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

variants.name: Smith Machine Squat
variants.setup: Set the bar at upper-chest height. Place feet slightly in front of the bar so your shins stay vertical at the bottom. Unhook and control the descent.

variants.name: Goblet Squat (DB)
variants.setup: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest, elbows tucked. Feet shoulder-width — sit between your heels, chest tall.

variants.name: Hack Squat (Machine)
variants.setup: Back flat on the pad, feet mid-platform shoulder-width. Release the handles and lower under control to just below parallel.

variants.name: Barbell Back Squat (Deep)
variants.setup: Rack the bar at upper-chest height, safeties low. Slightly wider stance, toes out — sink below parallel with a 1-sec pause for glute activation.

variants.name: Smith Machine Squat (Deep)
variants.setup: Feet slightly forward of the bar, wider than shoulder-width. Go below parallel with a controlled pause — the fixed path keeps balance easy.

variants.name: Goblet Squat (Deep)
variants.setup: Hold one heavy dumbbell at your chest. Sink as deep as mobility allows, elbows inside knees, 1-sec pause at the bottom.

variants.name: Leg Press (Deep, Wide)
variants.setup: Feet high and wide on the platform. Lower deep toward your chest without your hips rolling off the pad.

variants.name: Barbell Bench Press
variants.setup: Lie with eyes under the bar, feet planted. Retract shoulder blades, grip just outside shoulders, elbows ~45° on the way down.

variants.name: DB Bench Press
variants.setup: Sit with dumbbells on knees, kick back one at a time as you lie down. Press with a natural slight wrist rotation, elbows ~45°.

variants.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
variants.setup: Position the bench so the bar touches mid-chest. Same 45° elbow path — the fixed track spares stabilisers on heavy days.

variants.name: Machine Chest Press
variants.setup: Set the seat so handles sit at mid-chest height. Shoulder blades pinned back into the pad throughout.

variants.name: DB Bench Press (Flat)
variants.setup: Kick the dumbbells back one at a time as you lie down. Elbows ~45°, natural wrist rotation, stop just short of any shoulder pinch.

variants.name: Barbell Bench Press
variants.setup: Eyes under the bar, shoulder blades retracted, grip just outside shoulders. Elbows ~45° — never flared to 90°.

variants.name: Machine Chest Press
variants.setup: Handles at mid-chest height, shoulder blades pinned into the pad. Shoulder-friendly fixed path.

variants.name: Push-Up (Weighted)
variants.setup: Hands just outside shoulders, body in one line. Add a plate on your back or elevate feet to load it.

variants.name: DB Incline Press (30°)
variants.setup: Set the bench to ~30° (one or two notches up — not 45°+). Press up and slightly back, elbows ~45° from your torso.

variants.name: Barbell Incline Press (30°)
variants.setup: Low-incline bench in the rack, bar touches just below the collarbone. Moderate grip, elbows ~45°.

variants.name: Smith Incline Press
variants.setup: Slide a 30° bench under the bar so it meets your upper chest. Fixed path — good when pressing feels unstable.

variants.name: Incline Machine Press
variants.setup: Set seat height so handles start at upper-chest level. Drive up without shrugging.

variants.name: Walking Lunges (DB)
variants.setup: Dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Step forward into a lunge, knee tracking over toes, push through the front heel to step through.

variants.name: Walking Lunges (Bodyweight)
variants.setup: Hands on hips or clasped at chest. Same stride — use when dumbbells are taken or as a warm-up progression.

variants.name: Smith Machine Split Squat
variants.setup: Bar on upper traps, one foot forward one back, lower straight down. Swap legs each set — no walking space needed.

variants.name: Stationary Lunges (Barbell)
variants.setup: Bar on your back in the rack area. Lunge in place, alternating legs — safer than walking with a barbell.

variants.name: Walking Lunges (Long Stride)
variants.setup: Dumbbells at your sides, take a LONGER than comfortable stride and lean the torso slightly forward — this biases the glutes over the quads.

variants.name: Reverse Lunges (Long Stride)
variants.setup: Step backward into a long lunge, torso leaning slightly forward. Same glute bias, easier on the knees, no walking space needed.

variants.name: Smith Split Squat (Front Foot Forward)
variants.setup: Front foot placed well forward of the bar, slight forward torso lean. Fixed path lets you focus purely on the glute stretch.

variants.name: Walking Lunges (Bodyweight)
variants.setup: Long stride, hands at chest. Use for higher reps when dumbbells aren't free.

variants.name: Lateral Raise (DB)
variants.setup: Light dumbbells at your sides, slight forward lean, thumbs up a touch. Raise to shoulder height leading with the elbows.

variants.name: Lateral Raise (Cable)
variants.setup: Set the pulley at its lowest, stand side-on, handle in the far hand crossing your body. Constant tension through the whole arc.

variants.name: Lateral Raise (Machine)
variants.setup: Adjust the seat so shoulder joints line up with the machine's pivot. Pads just above the elbows, raise to parallel.

variants.name: Lateral Raise (Band)
variants.setup: Stand on the band, handle or loop in each hand. Raise to shoulder height — tension peaks at the top.

variants.name: Lateral Raise (Cable)
variants.setup: Lowest pulley, stand side-on, far hand grabs the handle across your body. Lead with the elbow, slight forward lean.

variants.name: Lateral Raise (DB)
variants.setup: Light dumbbells, strict form, raise to shoulder height with thumbs slightly up. Same movement when cables are taken.

variants.name: Lateral Raise (Machine)
variants.setup: Line your shoulders up with the pivot point, pads above the elbows. Smooth constant resistance.

variants.name: Lateral Raise (Band)
variants.setup: Stand on the middle of the band. Raise both arms to shoulder height, controlling the way down.

variants.name: Overhead Tricep Ext (Rope)
variants.setup: Rope on a low or mid pulley, face away, hands behind your head. Extend up and slightly forward, elbows fixed by your ears.

variants.name: Overhead Tricep Ext (DB)
variants.setup: Hold one dumbbell with both hands cupping the top plate. Lower behind your head, elbows pointing up, extend without flaring.

variants.name: Overhead Tricep Ext (Band)
variants.setup: Anchor the band low behind you, press overhead. Elbows stay tucked by your ears the whole set.

variants.name: Skull Crushers (EZ Bar)
variants.setup: Lie on a bench, EZ bar over your forehead. Lower to just behind the crown of the head, elbows fixed, press back up.

variants.name: Pallof Press (Cable)
variants.setup: Handle at chest height, stand side-on to the stack, feet shoulder-width. Press straight out and resist the pull to rotate. Switch sides.

variants.name: Pallof Press (Band)
variants.setup: Loop a band around an upright at chest height. Step out for tension, press straight out, resist rotation.

variants.name: Dead Bug
variants.setup: On your back, arms and knees up. Lower opposite arm and leg while pressing your low back into the floor. Anti-rotation substitute.

variants.name: Plank with Reach
variants.setup: From a forearm plank, reach one arm forward without letting the hips rotate. Alternate sides slowly.

variants.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
variants.setup: Stand centred inside the bar, handles at your sides. Brace hard, push the floor away — the neutral grip and centred load spare the spine.

variants.name: Conventional Deadlift
variants.setup: Bar over mid-foot, grip just outside legs, hips higher than knees. Brace, drag the bar up your shins, squeeze glutes at lockout.

variants.name: Rack Pull (Knee Height)
variants.setup: Set the bar on rack pins just below the knee. Shorter range, same hinge — good when pulling from the floor aggravates the back.

variants.name: DB Deadlift
variants.setup: Heavy dumbbells at your sides, hinge and drive up. Use when the trap bar and platform are taken.

variants.name: Conventional Deadlift
variants.setup: Bar over mid-foot, hands just outside legs, shoulders over the bar. Big brace, push the floor away, squeeze glutes hard at lockout.

variants.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
variants.setup: Stand centred in the bar with neutral handles. Same full-body pull with less spinal shear — good swap on heavy weeks.

variants.name: Rack Pull (Knee Height)
variants.setup: Pins just below the knee, same setup as a deadlift. Reduced range for when the low back needs a break.

variants.name: Sumo Deadlift
variants.setup: Wide stance, toes out, hands inside the knees. More upright torso — shifts work toward glutes and adductors.

variants.name: Chest-Supported Row
variants.setup: Set the chest pad so arms hang fully at the start. Pull to your lower ribs, squeeze 1 sec at the top — zero low-back stress.

variants.name: Chest-Supported DB Row
variants.setup: Lie face-down on a 30–45° incline bench, dumbbell in each hand. Row to your hips, squeeze the shoulder blades.

variants.name: Seal Row (Barbell)
variants.setup: Lie prone on an elevated flat bench, bar hanging below. Row to touch the bench underside — strict and back-friendly.

variants.name: Cable Row (Chest Braced)
variants.setup: Seated cable row with your chest against a pad or strict upright torso. Neutral grip, pull to the sternum.

variants.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
variants.setup: Chest on the pad, feet planted on the rests. Pull the handles to your ribs and squeeze hard — the pad removes all low-back stress.

variants.name: Chest-Supported DB Row
variants.setup: Face-down on an incline bench, row both dumbbells to your hips. Same pattern when the T-bar is taken.

variants.name: Machine Row (High Chest Pad)
variants.setup: Any plate-loaded row with a chest pad. Set the pad so you get a full stretch at the start of each rep.

variants.name: Seal Row (Barbell)
variants.setup: Prone on an elevated bench, barbell hanging below, row to the bench. Strict, shoulder-friendly.

variants.name: Lat Pulldown
variants.setup: Thighs snug under the pads, grip just outside shoulders. Pull to the upper chest — never behind the neck — full stretch up top.

variants.name: Pull-Ups
variants.setup: Overhand grip just outside shoulders, full hang. Pull your chest to the bar; add a band under a knee if you need assistance.

variants.name: Assisted Pull-Up (Machine)
variants.setup: Kneel on the assist pad, set counterweight so you fail around the target reps. Same pull-to-upper-chest path.

variants.name: Banded Pulldown (Kneeling)
variants.setup: Anchor a heavy band overhead, kneel below it. Pull the band to your upper chest — travel-friendly fallback.

variants.name: Lat Pulldown (Wide)
variants.setup: Wide grip on the long bar, thighs locked under the pads. Pull to the upper chest with a full stretch at the top — width builder.

variants.name: Pull-Up (Wide)
variants.setup: Wide overhand grip, full hang to chest-at-bar. Add band assistance if needed to stay in the 8–10 range.

variants.name: Assisted Pull-Up (Machine)
variants.setup: Counterweight set so the last rep is hard. Wide grip, pull to the upper chest, slow negative.

variants.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown (Heavy)
variants.setup: High pulley, arms nearly straight, sweep the bar to your thighs. Lat-focused fallback when bars and machines are busy.

variants.name: Close-Grip Pulldown (Neutral)
variants.setup: V-handle on the pulldown cable, slight lean back. Pull to the sternum, elbows driving to your hips — lower-lat emphasis, shoulder-friendly.

variants.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
variants.setup: Parallel handles, full hang. Pull chest to hands; band assistance keeps you in the rep range.

variants.name: Single-Arm Pulldown (Neutral)
variants.setup: D-handle, half-kneel or sit side-on. Pull to your ribs one arm at a time for a bigger stretch.

variants.name: Machine Pulldown (Neutral Handles)
variants.setup: Use the neutral grips on the pulldown machine, chest tall, pull to sternum.

variants.name: Leg Curl (Seated)
variants.setup: Knees lined up with the pivot, pad above the heels, thigh lock down. Curl fully, 3-sec return — the seated version stretches hams hardest.

variants.name: Leg Curl (Lying)
variants.setup: Hips pressed down on the pad, pad above heels. Curl to full flexion, slow eccentric.

variants.name: Nordic Curl (Assisted)
variants.setup: Anchor your ankles, lower your torso as slowly as possible, push back up with hands. Brutal — start assisted.

variants.name: Swiss Ball Leg Curl
variants.setup: Heels on a swiss ball in a glute bridge. Curl the ball toward you, hips high the whole time.

variants.name: Lying Leg Curl
variants.setup: Hips pressed into the pad, roller just above the heels. Curl fully and take 3 seconds on the way down — ACL-protective hamstring work.

variants.name: Seated Leg Curl
variants.setup: Knees at the pivot, thigh pad locked. Bigger stretch position — a great one-for-one swap.

variants.name: Swiss Ball Leg Curl
variants.setup: Bridge with heels on the ball, curl it in without dropping the hips. Use when machines are occupied.

variants.name: Nordic Curl (Assisted)
variants.setup: Ankles anchored, control the fall with your hamstrings, press back up. Progress slowly.

variants.name: Cable Face Pull
variants.setup: Rope at upper-chest height. Pull toward your face and externally rotate at the end — knuckles to the ceiling. Non-negotiable shoulder health work.

variants.name: Band Face Pull
variants.setup: Anchor a band at face height, pull to the bridge of your nose and rotate out. Perfect travel/home swap.

variants.name: Reverse Pec-Deck
variants.setup: Face the pad, handles at shoulder height, sweep arms back. Hits rear delts when cables are busy.

variants.name: Bent-Over Rear Delt Fly (DB)
variants.setup: Hinge to near-parallel, light dumbbells, raise out to the sides with soft elbows.

variants.name: Incline DB Curl
variants.setup: Bench at ~45–60°, arms hanging fully back for the stretch. Curl and supinate, keep the shoulders pinned back.

variants.name: Standing DB Curl
variants.setup: Curl with supination from your sides. Slightly less stretch — fine swap when the bench is taken.

variants.name: Cable Curl (Behind-Body)
variants.setup: Low pulley behind you, arm slightly back to mimic the incline stretch position.

variants.name: Barbell Curl (EZ)
variants.setup: EZ bar, hands at the angled grips, elbows pinned to your sides. Strict — no swinging.

variants.name: Dead Bug
variants.setup: On your back, arms up, knees at 90°. Press the low back into the floor and lower opposite arm and leg. Slow and controlled.

variants.name: Dead Bug (Band Anchored)
variants.setup: Hold a band anchored behind your head under light tension while performing the dead bug — the anti-extension bias increases.

variants.name: Bird Dog
variants.setup: On all fours, extend opposite arm and leg without the hips tipping. Pause 2 sec each rep.

variants.name: Pallof Press (Cable)
variants.setup: Chest-height handle, stand side-on, press out and resist rotation. Swap when you want standing core work.

variants.name: Leg Press (Moderate Foot)
variants.setup: Feet mid-platform, shoulder-width. Lower under control until hips begin to tuck, drive through the whole foot — quad emphasis.

variants.name: Hack Squat
variants.setup: Back flat on the pad, feet mid-platform. Same quad emphasis with a fixed track.

variants.name: Goblet Squat (DB)
variants.setup: Heavy dumbbell at the chest, controlled tempo squats — the fallback when machines are taken.

variants.name: Smith Machine Squat
variants.setup: Feet slightly forward, controlled depth. Spares the spine on a second squat-pattern day.

variants.name: Leg Press (High & Wide Foot)
variants.setup: Feet HIGH and WIDE on the platform, toes slightly out. Push through the heels — this shifts the load to glutes and hamstrings.

variants.name: Sumo Squat (DB/Goblet)
variants.setup: Wide stance, toes out 45°, dumbbell hanging at arms' length. Sit straight down, squeeze glutes at the top.

variants.name: Smith Squat (Wide, Feet Forward)
variants.setup: Wide stance with feet forward of the bar — heel drive biases glutes, machine handles balance.

variants.name: Belt Squat / Hack (Wide)
variants.setup: Any squat machine with a high-wide foot position, pushing through the heels.

variants.name: DB Overhead Press (Seated, Neutral)
variants.setup: Bench upright, palms facing each other. Press up and slightly in — the neutral grip keeps the shoulders happy. Stop if anything pinches.

variants.name: Machine Shoulder Press (Neutral)
variants.setup: Seat set so handles start at ear height. Use the neutral grips, press without shrugging.

variants.name: Landmine Press (Half-Kneeling)
variants.setup: Bar in a landmine or corner, half-kneel and press up-and-forward. The angle is very shoulder-friendly.

variants.name: Band Overhead Press
variants.setup: Stand on the band, press to lockout with neutral wrists. Light option for high-rep or travel days.

variants.name: DB Shoulder Press (Seated, Neutral)
variants.setup: Upright bench, palms facing each other, forearms vertical. Press up without flaring — stop before any pinching.

variants.name: Machine Shoulder Press (Neutral)
variants.setup: Handles start at ear height, neutral grips, core braced against the pad.

variants.name: Landmine Press (Half-Kneeling)
variants.setup: Half-kneeling, press the landmine up-and-forward. Great when overhead mobility is cranky.

variants.name: Arnold Press (Light)
variants.setup: Start palms-in at the chest, rotate out as you press. Keep it light and smooth.

variants.name: DB Chest Fly (Flat)
variants.setup: Soft elbows, arc the dumbbells out until you feel a pec stretch — never below shoulder depth. Squeeze back up the same arc.

variants.name: DB Chest Fly (Slight Incline)
variants.setup: Bench one notch up. Same soft-elbow arc with a touch more upper-chest bias.

variants.name: Cable Fly (Mid Height)
variants.setup: Pulleys at chest height, step forward with a slight stagger. Constant tension and a deep, safe stretch.

variants.name: Pec-Deck
variants.setup: Seat set so handles line up with mid-chest. Elbows slightly bent, controlled squeeze.

variants.name: DB Chest Fly (Slight Incline)
variants.setup: Bench one notch up, soft elbows, arc out to a pec stretch — don't drop below shoulder level. Stretch-focused.

variants.name: Cable Fly (Low-to-High)
variants.setup: Low pulleys, sweep up and in to shoulder height. Constant tension with an upper-chest bias.

variants.name: Pec-Deck
variants.setup: Handles at mid-chest, elbows soft, pause the squeeze 1 sec.

variants.name: Band Fly
variants.setup: Anchor the band behind you at chest height, press-fly forward until your hands meet.

variants.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (DB)
variants.setup: Rear foot laces-down on a bench, front foot 2–3 feet forward. Dumbbells at your sides, drop straight down, drive through the front heel.

variants.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Smith)
variants.setup: Bar on your back, rear foot on the bench behind the bar path. The fixed track removes the balance demand.

variants.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Bodyweight)
variants.setup: Hands at your chest, same setup. Use for higher reps or as a warm-up.

variants.name: Split Squat (Front Foot Elevated)
variants.setup: Front foot on a small plate or step, rear foot on the floor — easier balance, deeper range.

variants.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Glute)
variants.setup: LONG stance, rear foot on the bench, torso leaning forward ~20°. Sit back into the front heel — you should feel the glute stretch every rep.

variants.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Smith, Glute)
variants.setup: Long front-foot position ahead of the bar, forward torso lean. Machine balance lets you chase the glute stretch safely.

variants.name: Reverse Lunge (Deficit)
variants.setup: Stand on a small platform, step back and down into a long reverse lunge. Similar glute-dominant pattern.

variants.name: Step-Up (High Box)
variants.setup: Knee-height box, lean slightly forward, drive through the heel without pushing off the back leg.

variants.name: Tricep Pushdown (Rope)
variants.setup: Rope on the high pulley, elbows pinned to your sides. Push down and spread the rope apart at the bottom for the lateral head.

variants.name: Tricep Pushdown (Straight Bar)
variants.setup: Straight or EZ attachment, overhand grip. Roughly 25–30% heavier than your rope number.

variants.name: Band Pushdown
variants.setup: Band anchored overhead, elbows pinned. High-rep friendly — chase the squeeze.

variants.name: Bench Dips
variants.setup: Hands on a bench behind you, legs extended. Lower until upper arms are parallel, elbows pointing straight back.

variants.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
variants.setup: Kneel with the wheel under your shoulders. Roll out only as far as you can keep the low back from arching, pull back with your abs.

variants.name: Plank
variants.setup: Forearms down, body in one line, glutes squeezed. Stop the set the moment your hips sag.

variants.name: Cable Crunch (Kneeling)
variants.setup: Rope on the high pulley, kneel and crunch your elbows toward your thighs — flex the spine, don't pull with arms.

variants.name: Swiss Ball Rollout
variants.setup: Forearms on the ball, roll it forward keeping a rigid torso. Easier progression from the wheel.

variants.name: Romanian Deadlift
variants.setup: Bar starts at the hips. Soft knees, push the hips BACK until you feel a hamstring stretch (mid-shin), then squeeze glutes to stand. 3-sec lowering.

variants.name: DB Romanian Deadlift
variants.setup: Dumbbells in front of the thighs, same hip-hinge and 3-sec eccentric. Handy when the bars are taken.

variants.name: Smith RDL
variants.setup: Bar path fixed — stand a half-step forward so the bar tracks your legs while your hips travel back.

variants.name: Cable Pull-Through
variants.setup: Rope between the legs from a low pulley, hinge and snap the hips forward. Same pattern, lower load, joint-friendly.

variants.name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
variants.setup: From the hips: soft knees, hips travel back, bar glued to your legs to mid-shin. Squeeze the glutes to drive the hips forward. Control the 3-sec lowering.

variants.name: DB Romanian Deadlift
variants.setup: Same hinge with dumbbells brushing the thighs. Slightly easier to set up when racks are busy.

variants.name: Smith RDL
variants.setup: Stand half a step in front of the bar path. Hips back, stretch, drive forward.

variants.name: Single-Leg RDL (DB)
variants.setup: One dumbbell, opposite leg drifts back as you hinge. Halve the load, double the balance demand.

variants.name: Cable Row (Neutral Grip)
variants.setup: V-handle, knees soft, torso tall. Pull to the sternum, retract and depress the shoulder blades, resist the return.

variants.name: Machine Row (Neutral)
variants.setup: Chest pad set for a full stretch at the start. Neutral handles, pull to your ribs.

variants.name: Single-Arm DB Row
variants.setup: Hand and knee on the bench, flat back. Row to your hip, full stretch at the bottom.

variants.name: Banded Seated Row
variants.setup: Band around your feet, sit tall and row to the sternum. Travel-friendly.

variants.name: Single-Arm DB Row
variants.setup: Opposite hand and knee on the bench, back flat. Let the shoulder reach at the bottom, then row to your hip — the free arm moves naturally.

variants.name: Single-Arm Cable Row
variants.setup: D-handle at low-mid height, staggered stance. Same reach-and-pull with constant tension.

variants.name: Meadows Row (Landmine)
variants.setup: Landmine bar, side-on stance, overhand grip on the sleeve. Big stretch, elbows out slightly.

variants.name: Machine Row (Single Arm)
variants.setup: One arm at a time on the chest-supported machine — pin the chest, full stretch.

variants.name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
variants.setup: Upper back on a bench, bar padded over the hips, feet planted so shins are vertical at the top. Full lockout, 1-sec squeeze, chin tucked.

variants.name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
variants.setup: Set the pad over the hips and belt in if available. Same full lockout and squeeze — much faster to load.

variants.name: Glute Bridge (Barbell, Floor)
variants.setup: Shoulders on the floor, bar over the hips. Shorter range but very stable — good when benches are taken.

variants.name: DB Hip Thrust
variants.setup: Back on the bench, heavy dumbbell across the hips. Use for higher-rep sets.

variants.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
variants.setup: Upper back on the bench, padded bar over the hips, vertical shins at lockout. Drive through the heels, 2-sec squeeze at the top — PRIMARY glute builder.

variants.name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
variants.setup: Belt or pad over the hips, back on the machine's rest. Same lockout and squeeze, quicker setup.

variants.name: Smith Hip Thrust
variants.setup: Bench perpendicular under the Smith bar, pad the bar. Fixed path makes heavy loading easy.

variants.name: Glute Bridge (Barbell, Floor)
variants.setup: From the floor when benches are busy — shorter range, still squeeze hard 2 sec.

variants.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
variants.setup: Upper back on the bench, one foot planted, other leg lifted. Drive to full lockout without the hips tilting — fixes L/R imbalances.

variants.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust (DB)
variants.setup: Add a dumbbell over the working hip once bodyweight passes the top of the rep range.

variants.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge (Floor)
variants.setup: From the floor, one leg up. Shorter range — squeeze 2 sec at the top.

variants.name: B-Stance Hip Thrust
variants.setup: Non-working heel lightly planted for balance, ~80% of the load on the working leg. Halfway step to a true single-leg.

variants.name: Reverse Fly (DB)
variants.setup: Hinge to near-parallel, light dumbbells, soft elbows. Sweep out and back, thumbs slightly down, slow return.

variants.name: Band Pull-Apart
variants.setup: Band at shoulder height, arms straight. Pull apart until it touches your chest, control back. High reps.

variants.name: Reverse Pec-Deck
variants.setup: Face the pad, arms at shoulder height, sweep back with a 1-sec hold.

variants.name: Cable Reverse Fly (Cross)
variants.setup: Pulleys at shoulder height, grab the opposite handle in each hand, sweep out and back.

variants.name: Reverse Fly (DB)
variants.setup: Hinge to near-parallel, soft elbows, sweep the dumbbells out and back with slow eccentrics — direct rear-delt prehab.

variants.name: Reverse Fly (Cable, Cross)
variants.setup: Pulleys at shoulder height, arms crossed grabbing opposite handles. Constant tension through the sweep.

variants.name: Reverse Pec-Deck
variants.setup: Chest on the pad, handles at shoulder height, squeeze the blades together each rep.

variants.name: Band Pull-Apart
variants.setup: Arms straight at shoulder height, pull the band to your chest. Great high-rep finisher.

variants.name: Seated Calf Raise
variants.setup: Pads on the knees, balls of the feet on the platform. Full stretch at the bottom, 2-sec pause at the top — bone-density loading.

variants.name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
variants.setup: Shoulders under the pads, full stretch and 2-sec top pause. Hits the gastrocnemius more with straight knees.

variants.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise (DB)
variants.setup: Ball of one foot on a step, dumbbell in the same-side hand. Full range, slow tempo.

variants.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
variants.setup: Balls of the feet on the bottom edge of the leg-press platform. Stretch, pause, press.

variants.name: Hammer Curl (DB)
variants.setup: Neutral grip (palms facing in), elbows pinned. Curl without swinging — brachialis and forearm work with a shoulder-friendly grip.

variants.name: Rope Hammer Curl (Cable)
variants.setup: Rope on the low pulley, neutral grip, constant tension through the curl.

variants.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
variants.setup: Curl each dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder — extra brachialis bias.

variants.name: Band Hammer Curl
variants.setup: Stand on the band, neutral wrists, strict curls. Travel fallback.

variants.name: Side Plank
variants.setup: Elbow under shoulder, body in one line, hips lifted. Hold — the set ends when the hips start to drop.

variants.name: Suitcase Carry (DB)
variants.setup: One heavy dumbbell at your side, walk tall without leaning. Swap hands each length — lateral core under load.

variants.name: Suitcase Carry (Kettlebell)
variants.setup: Same single-side carry with a kettlebell — the offset handle adds grip work.

variants.name: Side Plank (Feet Elevated)
variants.setup: Feet on a bench for a harder lever. Keep the line from head to heels.

variants.name: Cable Kickback
variants.setup: Ankle cuff on the low pulley, hinge slightly and hold the frame. Kick back and up, squeeze 1 sec at peak — don't arch the low back.

variants.name: Glute Bridge
variants.setup: On the floor, feet planted close to the glutes. Drive the hips up, 2-sec squeeze at the top. Add a dumbbell or band when it gets easy.

variants.name: Machine Kickback
variants.setup: Chest on the pad, foot on the platform, press back and up through the heel to full hip extension.

variants.name: Banded Glute Bridge
variants.setup: Mini-band above the knees, bridge and press the knees out at the top — extra glute-med work.

variants.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
variants.setup: Rope or straight bar on the high pulley, hinge slightly, arms nearly straight. Sweep to your thighs and squeeze the lats at the bottom.

variants.name: DB Pullover
variants.setup: Upper back across a bench, one dumbbell held over the chest. Lower behind your head to a lat stretch, pull back over.

variants.name: Band Straight-Arm Pulldown
variants.setup: Band anchored overhead, hinge and sweep down with straight arms.

variants.name: Machine Pullover
variants.setup: If your gym has one — set the seat so shoulders align with the pivot, sweep and squeeze.

variants.name: Sumo Squat (DB/Goblet)
variants.setup: Wide stance, toes out 45°, dumbbell hanging between your legs (or goblet at the chest). Sit straight down, squeeze glutes and adductors at the top.

variants.name: Sumo Squat (Kettlebell)
variants.setup: Kettlebell by the horns between the legs. Same wide-stance sit — the handle makes heavy sets comfier.

variants.name: Smith Sumo Squat
variants.setup: Wide stance under the bar, toes out. Fixed path for heavier finisher sets.

variants.name: Sumo Leg Press
variants.setup: Feet wide and high on the platform, toes out. Push through the heels.

variants.name: Cable Pull-Through
variants.setup: Rope on the low pulley, face away, rope between the legs. Hinge back, then snap the hips forward and squeeze — low joint stress.

variants.name: Banded Pull-Through
variants.setup: Band anchored low behind you, same hinge-and-squeeze. Home-friendly.

variants.name: DB Romanian Deadlift (Light)
variants.setup: Light RDL focusing on the glute squeeze at lockout — same pattern, free weights.

variants.name: 45° Back Extension (Glute Focus)
variants.setup: Round the upper back slightly, tuck the chin, squeeze glutes to raise. Don't hyperextend.

variants.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
variants.setup: Hinge to ~45°, overhand grip outside the knees. Pull to your lower chest, squeeze the mid-back, no torso heave — PRIMARY back builder.

variants.name: Pendlay Row
variants.setup: Torso parallel, bar starts dead on the floor each rep. Explosive pull, strict reset.

variants.name: Chest-Supported Row (Machine)
variants.setup: Same rowing pattern with zero low-back demand — smart swap after heavy deadlifts.

variants.name: Bent-Over DB Row (Two-Arm)
variants.setup: Hinge with a dumbbell in each hand, row both to your hips. Use when bars are taken.
